name: Apollo 16
intro: John Young here! We're the first to land in the Moon's bright highlands.
Scientists expect volcanic rocks. Spoiler: they are in for a surprise.
The other finalist was Alphonsus, a big crater with dark spots.
Land with the Sun low, and let's go rock hunting.
briefing: The main engine of our mothership is wobbling. We had to wait in orbit for hours!
Now we're cleared to land. Choose the site.
fact: Apollo 16 found no volcanic rocks at Descartes, only rocks smashed by ancient impacts.

alarm.title: Engine Wobble
alarm.alarm: MAIN ENGINE GIMBAL FAULT — LANDING ON HOLD
alarm.briefing: Our mothership's main engine is shaking! Houston kept us waiting for hours. Now it's go: choose where we land!
